title: Grateful Dead Live at The Matrix on 1966-11-29

ai_review.summary: Solid soundboard capture featuring a standout Pigpen‑led Big Boy Pete performance with lively Jerry/Bob vocal interplay.
ai_review.review: The recording, taken from the soundboard, is generally praised as a good source despite limited technical commentary. Musically the show shines on the rare Pigpen version of "Big Boy Pete," where Bob and Jerry trade verses and the band delivers an unusually rocking rendition. Overall listeners found the performance enjoyable and worth downloading.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers are favorable; one gives a perfect 5‑star rating for the musical highlight, while the other rates it average but still calls it a great recording. The show’s standout song and solid soundboard source justify a high rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the recording as 'great' or simply note it didn't scare away downloaders; no specific issues such as dropouts or muddiness are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure were provided.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for trading lyrics with Bob on "Big Boy Pete" and delivering an energetic vocal performance.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for joining Jerry in lyrical trade during the Pigpen‑led rendition of "Big Boy Pete".
